probes.blocker: Legacy question writers must become draft-only or be replaced by atomic trusted publication before this can be secure for live content. Signed head replay by a compromised Admin writer is also not prevented by signature alone.

limitations: Actual web SDK and unchanged learning-draft module with import-only instrumentation; dashboard/story query shapes, not full application UI navigation.
30 synthetic users run sequentially in one Chrome page; concurrency measured separately in classroom backend workload.
No teacher browser trace or browser grading UI in this run.
Successful SDK operation counts exclude the denied private-catalog get; rule-dependent and index reads are not measured. Network request counts are not document read counts.
No production App Check attestation or hosted Netlify test.
